steps.task: C1 C2 C3 C4: extend loadConfig with dueTimes (on only when DUE_TIMES is exactly on) and responseHoursUrgent/High/Normal/Low via wholeNumber defaults 4/24/72/168 including 0.
C5 C6: add due to ticketRecord and readTicket with time() like created; keep VERSION 1; invalid due is DataFileError naming tickets[n].due.
C7 C8: optional hours on TicketStore constructor and open default 4/24/72/168; create assigns due from created plus hours[priority]; leave CREATED_FIELDS and create audit without due.
C9: keep stored due through update, transition, and a new TicketStore on the same snapshot with different hours.
C10 C11: on open, backfill missing due from stored created and priority then save() when persistence exists, without apply/audit/updated; keep dues already present.
C12 C13 C14: add optional dueTimes to createApp default off; project ticket JSON without due unless dueTimes is on; POST/PATCH due stays 400 unknown field: due.
C15: TicketStore.list extra-AND overdue true as ACTIVE and now > due; do not put overdue into matchesFilters; do not add a permanent overdue key to parseListQuery.
C16 C17: GET /tickets reads overdue itself; when dueTimes is on, overdue=true uses store list AND and other values 400 invalid; when off, ignore overdue.
C18 C19 C20: createService passes hours into TicketStore.open and dueTimes into createApp so env-backed HTTP and flag-off persist work.

criteria.text: loadConfig returns responseHoursUrgent 4, responseHoursHigh 24, responseHoursNormal 72, responseHoursLow 168 when those variables are unset or empty, and RESPONSE_HOURS_* '0' is the number 0. Confirm by: DT-9 and the hours-0 overlays of DT-7 and DT-11 in node --test test/due-times.test.js; pass when loadConfig({}) hours are 4/24/72/168, RESPONSE_HOURS_LOW empty uses 168, and a '0' overlay is the number 0. Due === created from hours 0 is C7. Serves R-3.

loadConfig throws ConfigError naming RESPONSE_HOURS_URGENT for nope, -5, and 4.5. Confirm by: DT-10 in node --test test/due-times.test.js; pass when each throw is ConfigError and the message matches /RESPONSE_HOURS_URGENT/. Serves R-3.

dueTimes is the string on only when DUE_TIMES is exactly on; unset, 1, true, and ON leave it not on. Confirm by: DT-30 in node --test test/due-times.test.js; pass when those overlays match unset HTTP (POST has no due key). Serves R-8.
loadConfig contract comment names DUE_TIMES and RESPONSE_HOURS_URGENT/HIGH/NORMAL/LOW. Confirm by: grep DUE_TIMES and RESPONSE_HOURS in src/config.js; pass when both match. Serves R-3 R-8.

toDocument keeps version 1 and ticketRecord names due; extra unknown ticket keys are dropped; a ticket without due still loads so open can backfill. Confirm by: DT-32 DT-31 DT-33 in node --test test/due-times.test.js; pass when a due-bearing save has version 1 and due, a record without due loads, and fixtures/persistence-1.4.0.js loads both tickets with no due key. Serves R-9 AD-4.

A ticket due that is present but not an ISO time refuses start with DataFileError naming tickets[0].due. Confirm by: DT-26 in node --test test/due-times.test.js; pass when the error message matches /tickets\[0\]\.due/. Serves R-7.

TicketStore constructor and open take optional hours defaulting to urgent 4 high 24 normal 72 low 168; create at C0 assigns due created plus those hours (high 2025-09-02T08:15:00.000Z, urgent 2025-09-01T12:15:00.000Z, normal 2025-09-04T08:15:00.000Z, low 2025-09-08T08:15:00.000Z) and hours 0 yields due === created. Confirm by: DT-5 DT-6 DT-7 DT-27 in node --test test/due-times.test.js; pass when those due strings match. Serves R-2 R-3 AD-2 AD-3.

Create audit changes keys stay title, priority, requester, status; CREATED_FIELDS does not gain due; create still enqueues ticket.created only. Confirm by: DT-16 in node --test test/due-times.test.js; pass when GET audit create entry changes keys are exactly those four. Serves R-5 AD-7.

A stored due is unchanged by PATCH priority, a transition, and a restart with different hours. Confirm by: DT-12 DT-13 in node --test test/due-times.test.js; pass when T-0001 due stays 2025-09-02T08:15:00.000Z through that walk. Serves R-4.

TicketStore.open fills missing due from each ticket's stored created and priority using current hours, then save() when persistence exists, without audit or updated change. Confirm by: DT-24 in node --test test/due-times.test.js on the spec two-ticket version-1 document (T-0001 high, T-0002 low); pass when the file stays version 1, dues are 2025-09-02T08:15:00.000Z and 2025-09-08T08:15:00.000Z, both updated remain C0, and audit is []. Serves R-7 AD-3.
Tickets that already have due keep those strings on a later open even when hours change. Confirm by: DT-25 DT-28 in node --test test/due-times.test.js; pass when those due strings stay. Serves R-7.

createApp omits due on POST, GET list items, GET by id, PATCH, and transition unless dueTimes is on; with the switch off Object.keys of a created ticket are exactly id,title,priority,requester,status,created,updated. Confirm by: DT-1 DT-14 DT-15 in node --test test/due-times.test.js; pass when flag-off keys match that list and flag-on bodies include due 2025-09-02T08:15:00.000Z. Serves R-1 R-5 R-8 AD-5.

POST /tickets and PATCH /tickets/:id with due answer 400 invalid unknown field: due. Confirm by: DT-2 DT-3 in node --test test/due-times.test.js; pass when status is 400, body.error.code is invalid, and the message matches /unknown field: due/. Serves R-1.
createApp contract comment names dueTimes and that HTTP ticket JSON omits due unless dueTimes is on. Confirm by: grep dueTimes in src/app.js; pass when it matches. Serves R-8 AD-5.

TicketStore.list treats overdue true as an extra AND of status in ACTIVE (open, in_progress) and clock.now() strictly after due; listings without overdue stay the 1.4.0 match; matchesFilters stays OR. Confirm by: DT-17 DT-19 DT-20 DT-21 DT-22 DT-23 in node --test test/due-times.test.js; pass when overdue ids and paging match those oracles. Serves R-6 AD-6.

While dueTimes is on, GET /tickets?overdue=true uses that AND and any other present overdue value is 400 invalid. Confirm by: DT-17 DT-18 in node --test test/due-times.test.js; pass when overdue=true returns the overdue active ids and overdue=false, 1, TRUE, and empty each return 400. Serves R-6.

While dueTimes is not on, GET /tickets?overdue=true is ignored like an unknown query key. Confirm by: DT-29 in node --test test/due-times.test.js; pass when flag-off overdue=true at C0 still lists T-0001. Serves R-8.

createService passes loadConfig hours into TicketStore.open and dueTimes into createApp, so RESPONSE_HOURS_HIGH 2 with DUE_TIMES on at C0 yields due 2025-09-01T10:15:00.000Z, and a flag-off create still stores due. Confirm by: DT-8 DT-29 in node --test test/due-times.test.js; pass when those dues match and the data file contains due while HTTP omits it. Serves R-3 R-8 AD-1.
Existing tests still pass as they are. Confirm by: npm test; pass when the 1.4.0 titles still pass and test/helpers.js plus existing test/*.test.js are unmodified. Serves R-10.

New node:test cases for due times live in test/due-times.test.js and npm test runs them with the existing suite. Confirm by: node --test test/due-times.test.js printing DT-1 through DT-33; pass when that file runs and package.json test remains node --test. Serves R-11.

headline: Due times persist on every ticket, HTTP shows due only when DUE_TIMES=on, and overdue lists open work; proven by node --test test/due-times.test.js (DT-1..DT-33) and npm test.
